_comment: Editorial content for GCWLPRS, which is a redeemable-share line of Ghani ChemWorld Limited rather than a separate business. The exchange's record labels the security "Ghani Chemworld Limited(PRS)", i.e. its partially redeemable shares; that label is quoted rather than any terms of the instrument, which are not set out in the sources read. The profile therefore describes the issuer, and products is empty. No image is attached.
description: GCWLPRS is the symbol under which Ghani ChemWorld Limited's partially redeemable shares (PRS) are quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange; the exchange's record lists the security as "Ghani Chemworld Limited(PRS)". It is a share class of Ghani ChemWorld Limited, not a separate business: that company was incorporated on 31 July 2024 as a wholly owned subsidiary of Ghani Chemical Industries Limited and took over the group's calcium carbide project, at a plant in Hattar Special Economic Zone, under a scheme approved by the Lahore High Court on 20 February 2025.
sourceNote: Security identity from the PSX data portal record for GCWLPRS at https://dps.psx.com.pk/company/GCWLPRS, which lists it as "Ghani Chemworld Limited(PRS)" with no separate company profile (accessed 2026-10-17); the issuer description is from the company's website ghanichemworld.com (about, industry and contact pages).
